response.sql: WITH budget_with_event AS (SELECT b.*, e.status FROM budget b INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), event_level_stats AS (SELECT link_to_event, status, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, AVG((spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) as avg_overspend_rate FROM budget_with_event GROUP BY link_to_event, status), status_level_stats AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate FROM event_level_stats GROUP BY status), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as overall_avg_remaining FROM status_level_stats) SELECT s.status, s.avg_remaining, s.avg_overspend_rate, s.avg_remaining / o.overall_avg_remaining as remaining_ratio FROM status_level_stats s CROSS JOIN overall_stats o ORDER BY s.status
